Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. Effects don't activate from breeding areas, so the card isn't treated as a black card. You can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a black Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: This card is in my breeding area. Can I digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a black Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No. You must trash a card in your hand in order to activate it.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card’s effect when my hand is empty?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand to have this Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
[All Turns] This Digimon is also treated as black.
